findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 258 requests to 50 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

9 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), criteo.com (Criteo, advertising), demdex.net (Adobe, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), parsely.com (Parse.ly, analytics), rubiconproject.com (Magnite, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement), taboola.com (Taboola, advertising).
16 cookies were set by third-party domains (55 cookies in total).
